profile.headline: Software Engineer at Company A
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with extensive experience in React, TypeScript, Redux, MobX, and Node and I am seeking to help make the world a better and equitable place.  I am passionate about creating intuitive and visually pleasing software that solves a problem for a user, making their life simpler.  

My Technical Skills include:  
React | TypeScript | Redux | MobX | React Native | Node JS | GraphQL | Apollo | Express | JavaScript |  Webpack | jQuery | Kotlin | MongoDB | Mongoose | HTML5 | CSS3 | SASS | Responsive Design | REST APIs | JSON | MERN Stack | Git | GitHub | Agile | Scrum | Kanban

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Built and maintained a large-scale React + TypeScript application for Toyota/Lexus offer generation, used by internal stakeholders across multiple regions
● Developed reusable UI components in a shared design system, improving feature delivery speed and cross-team consistency
● Integrated GraphQL APIs using Apollo Client, optimizing data fetching and state management with MobX
● Wrote unit tests and actively participated in code reviews to maintain code quality and reduce regressions
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · MobX · TypeScript · Apollo GraphQL · CSS

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
● Built & designed consumer facing website with 2 engineers & 1 designer (React, Redux, Material UI)
● Updated & re-built eCommerce feature with another engineer (React, Redux, Material UI)
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Responsive Web Design · Material-UI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and built frontend of mobile app with 2 stakeholders and 1 UX designer (React Native)
● Learned React Native and delivered demo app (66% ahead of schedule)
● Conducted QA on mobile devices (iOS and Android) by using React Navigation to script integration tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Built the frontend for a prototype marketplace app with 1 other UX designer (HTML, CSS, Bootstrap)
● Advised team to reduce scope of project.  This allowed us to complete the MVP ahead of schedule and iterate on next phases of product development (2 weeks ahead of schedule)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and built eCommerce & subscription feature with another engineer (React, Kotlin)
● Maintained and rebuilt User Dashboard web application (React, Kotlin)
● Onboarded 1 new engineer to codebase

positions.title: Front End Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Created a web application for Oreo during the Superbowl with another UX designer & engineer (React)
● Developed an AR Snapchat filter for a museum marketing team

positions.title: Apprentice Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed, created, and deployed fully functional mobile-first applications in collaboration with a senior web developer using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, & CSS3
● Managed the production of my projects using TravisCI and Git version control
● Focused on designing visually appealing User Interfaces and a simple User Experience

positions.title: Theatrical Finance & Administration
positions.description:
● Performed data entry of earnings made from Lionsgate films distributed to theaters across the US
● Handled all Accounts Receivable billing & collections of film rental from all theaters in the US playing Lionsgate films
● Interfaced with the sales team to maintain spreadsheets and database queries

positions.title: Accounting Clerk
positions.description:
● Performed data entry of development executive and executive assistants tax information and timecard information into Fox payroll systems
● Interfaced with Accounting Managers and Payroll Supervisors when implementing rate changes for executives and assistants 
● Interacted with Production Managers & Production Supervisors when adding new executives or assistants into the Fox payroll system, obtaining and entering in all necessary information
● Organized financial documentation and charges to the corresponding Fox television show and season
● Wrote journal entries for Accounting Analysts, explaining in detail the charges that were made to the Fox drama shows
● Interacted with accountants from various Fox shows, answering questions regarding what charges were made to their specific show and providing them with financial documentation
● Research and prepare accounting documentation for costs, reports, and audits
● Calculate and post charges to departmental accounts, & load weekly costs in production accounting systems

positions.title: Payroll Clerk
positions.description:
● Performed all talks associated with preparation and completion of clients payroll in a timely manner, successfully handling all processes and procedures
● Maintained comprehensive knowledge of federal and state wage and hour laws as well as union contracts appropriate to the clients and the type of payroll assigned
● Manually calculated timecards according to federal and stage wage and hour laws and applicable union contracts
● Performed quality control checks of payroll audit reports, including handling fees, deductions, manual taxes, and tax codes
● Maintained extensive and excellent contact with clients and clients employees, including responding to and following up with clients, employee requests, and concerns in a timely manner
● Responsible for protecting businesses and the clients by keeping information confidential and secure

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description:
● Aided the Art Department in ordering necessary materials and making sure all deliveries were correct in quantity to ensure building the proper set.  Created Word & Excel spreadsheets to keep track of all information
● Performed administrative duties, filed & processed paperwork of various shooting locations and created detailed lists of how much money being used in buying new materials for the different shooting locations
● Served as a liaison between the executive producers and production coordinators
● Handled all incoming & outgoing phone calls to the MasterChef Studio, answering questions and directing callers to the correct people

positions.title: Production Intern
positions.description:
● Managed daily summary sheets of which guests to arrive, conversation topics during the interview, & scripts of all comedy sketches.  Inspected all information to ensure no mistakes were made and organized all paperwork
● Created detailed  lists and Word/Excel spreadsheets to keep track of which guests arriving, what conversation topics being used during interview, the date, & which comedy sketch being used
● Coordinated with staff to ensure credits sequence were accurate and up-to-date
● Served as a liaison between the director and post-production coordinator
● Handled all incoming & outgoing phone calls to the control room

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
● Educated elementary school students with a specialty in Math,                          English literature, and vocabulary
● Helped students raise SAT score from previous year
● Prepared lesson plans, homework assignments, and tests
● Led classroom discussions and executed lesson plans based   on the subject at hand

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
● Managed & updated the marketing calendar with significant industry dates
● Analyzed & compared weekly sales and updated the marketing reference report
● Used specific tracking tools such as Soundscan to measure album and digital sales
● Pulled shipping reports daily and ordered/organized products

positions.title: Digital Communications Intern
positions.description:
● Researched digital publicity, digital promotions, and social media trends
● Interacted with core fans in social networks, message boards, and video upload sites
● Created target lists, aided in reporting for campaigns, and managed contacts database

projects.title: Chatty
projects.description: An application that allows users to text and message with others. Users can create a username and chatroom, and chat with others within the rooms they've created!

projects.title: Covid 19 Tracking App
projects.description: With the current pandemic occurring around the world due to Covid-19, I wanted to create an application that could help & inform, & I wanted to do that with my passion for programming. That led me to find an amazing video from the YouTube channel JavaScript Mastery which had an informative tutorial on how to build a Covid 19 Tracking application. This application is able to show the data on the number of infected, recovered, & deaths due to Covid-19 both globally and by individual countries.
